integrity: The result is a theorem with a self-contained unrestricted proof and a separately executable finite checker. No independent audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty outward forests with immediate-child accessibility only; no claim for general DAGs, transitive frames, counting modalities, or infinite forests. Historical priority outside inspected terminology is not resolved. Finite code corroborates but is not a replacement for general proof.
title: Leaf-injection rigidity and a shape-free generator census for finite modal forests
